verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an authenticator or credential app, since comparable products in this category ship CLIs. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a Microsoft Authenticator CLI. The documented surface is a mobile app (sign-in approvals, OTP codes, backup, password export), and the probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
